rationale: The evaluator feedback on iteration 4 candidate approved the cautious tuning trend of increasing kp to 4 and lowering kd to 8 to improve responsiveness and fine-tune damping, while reducing base speed to 1.5 to enhance control stability. However, the race data shows that the slalom track remains unsolved with zero finishes, significant line loss events (0.25), and relatively high steering oscillation (0.2645). This suggests the robot struggles with stability and line tracking on the most challenging track. To address this, I will follow the evaluator's requested changes: reduce kp to 3 to lower responsiveness and potential oscillations, increase kd to 9 to enhance damping, and slightly increase base speed to 1.6 to improve progress and stability balance. Integral gain ki remains at 0.5 to maintain integral action. Sensor weights and line loss strategy remain unchanged as no issues were reported with them. Geometry remains the same, as it has proven stable and effective. I expect these changes to reduce steering oscillations, improve line tracking stability, and increase progress and completion rates, especially on the slalom track. I request measurements of completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to verify these effects in the next race.
